summary: Iteration 47 revision E2E test (backend + frontend). Backend: re-ran the 4 existing iter46/47/51 suites (86 passed, 1 skipped) and added a new 36-case edge-case suite (/app/backend/tests/test_iter47_edge_cases.py) covering support ticket lifecycle + invalid status transitions + CSAT bounds + SLA config persistence + dashboard, /api/reports/customer_support shape, ecommerce commission-before-live guard (create/update/bulk), vendor filters/sort/business_value, partner tag CRUD + AND tag filter + min_rating + rate-card in-place edit + status-change guard/override, and hard-delete validation incl. a full create→hard-delete→verify-removal roundtrip. Combined result: 121 passed / 1 failed / 1 skipped (99%). Frontend: verified login, Partners (Manage Tags dialog add/list, tag AND combo filter, rating filter options '4 stars & above', sort Rating/Business), Partner detail (Edit dialog save, rate-card edit-in-place 500->777 persisted, active-assignment guard -> inline error + override reason + Override & Save -> status inactive), Vendors (category/status/district/search/sort filters, business value line, district + payment terms in New Vendor form), AMC Customer Support tab (4 KPI cards, ticket create TKT-00057, detail dialog, assign TechA, transition in_progress, Close+Rate CSAT 5 -> status closed and avg CSAT moved 4.60->4.64, SLA Config dialog with 8 priority inputs saved and persisted via API), Reports -> Customer Support renders, Ecommerce (6 edit-platform pencils, 'Edit Platform' dialog with 'Reference Commission %', listing dialog with required 'Listing Commission %'), Hard Delete on Direct Sales / Purchase Inbound / Delivery Outbound (reason textarea, empty-reason inline error 'A reason is required', successful delete + list refresh), CEO Dashboard support snapshot (4 KPI cards) + Export PDF click with no console error.

critical.issue: Bypasses the iteration-47 'every live listing must carry its own commission_pct' rule. A draft listing with platform_commission_pct=null can be flipped to status='live' via bulk-status (verified: listing went live with null commission). POST /listings and PUT /listings/{id} correctly return 400.

minor.issue: first_response_at is stamped on ANY first update (e.g. editing only the description or category), not just on a real first response/assignment. This silently improves the response-SLA compliance numbers used by the CEO snapshot and the customer_support report.
Response is correct (summary.response_breach_pct / avg_csat, technician_rows, top_recurring present) but technician_rows is never rendered by the UI - see frontend issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Backend returns technician_rows (technician, resolved, avg_csat, avg_resolution_hours) but the report body never renders a technician-performance table (only CSAT / breach / top-recurring appear). Requirement (3) asked for technician performance in this report.

Hard Delete button is hidden for sales with status 'returned' or 'cancelled' (all rows on the page were cancelled, so 0 buttons rendered). Purchase Inbound and Delivery Outbound DO show Hard Delete for cancelled records, so behaviour is inconsistent - admins cannot purge cancelled/returned sales, which is the most likely hard-delete case.

GST warning acknowledgement checkbox (data-testid='gst-ack-checkbox') never appeared for the sale tested (invoice <30 days old, so _is_gst_reported=false). Not verified end-to-end - needs an older invoice to confirm the GST warning path works.
Save button testid is 'save-partner-edit-btn', not 'save-partner-btn' as stated in the test request (works, but spec/testid mismatch for future scripts).
Payment Terms input has no data-testid (District has 'vendor-district-input'). Add e.g. data-testid='vendor-payment-terms-input'.

integration_issues.issue: React console error 'Encountered two children with the same key, TEST_Payment_Customer' repeated ~5x - list keyed by customer name instead of a unique id; can duplicate/omit rows.

issues: Inline error surfaces the raw developer-facing API wording: 'Set force_status_change=true with a status_change_reason to override' - should be user-facing copy.
Avg Resolution (hrs) shows 0 for tickets resolved within the same minute - consider showing minutes or '<1h' instead of 0.

Render technician_rows (technician performance) in the Customer Support report on ReportsPage.
Show Hard Delete for cancelled/returned direct sales (or document why sales differ from PO/delivery).
Only stamp support ticket first_response_at on assignment / status move away from 'open', not on every first update.
Replace the raw API status-guard message with user-facing copy in the Edit Partner dialog.
Fix the duplicate React key warning (key by id, not customer name).
Add data-testid to the New Vendor Payment Terms input.
critical_code_review_comments: ecommerce.py bulk_update_status() does a blind update_many with no per-listing validation - it is the single hole in the otherwise-correct commission-before-live rule.
support.py update_ticket(): 'if not existing.get("first_response_at"): update["first_response_at"] = now' runs regardless of what field changed - SLA metric integrity bug.
server.py is 7773 lines; the new report_type branches and hard-delete endpoints should move into modules (reports.py / hard_delete.py) per the <700-line guideline.
_is_gst_reported() uses a naive >30-days heuristic - acceptable as a warning but should read the actual GST filing period from company settings.

Login sets a session cookie; there is no access_token in the login response. Tag filter pills use data-testid='tag-filter-<lowercased-name>'. Partner edit save = 'save-partner-edit-btn'. rca_of_the_issue: ecommerce.py bulk_update_status() performs db.ecommerce_listings.update_many({_id:{$in:...}},{$set:{status}}) with no validation, whereas create_listing() and update_listing() both raise 400 when status=='live' and platform_commission_pct is None. Repro: POST /api/ecommerce/listings (status='draft', no platform_commission_pct) -> POST /api/ecommerce/listings/bulk-status {listing_ids:[id], status:'live'} -> GET /api/ecommerce/listings shows status='live', platform_commission_pct=null. Fix: load the affected listings first and reject (or skip with a per-id error report) any without their own commission when the target status is 'live'.
